dedupe_keys.name: ptv vissim microscopic multimodal traffic simulation software

description: PTV Vissim is commercial software for microscopic, multimodal traffic simulation. It reproduces the movements and interactions of all road users, using motion and interaction models for pedestrians, lane-based and non-lane-based vehicles, micromobility and automated vehicles, and it also covers rail and urban air mobility. Planners use it to test traffic signal programs, including priority with vehicle-to-infrastructure communication, street redesigns, new developments and corridor and intersection performance, and to evaluate congestion, emissions and safety; it is also used for pedestrian flows in buildings such as airports, at events and in automotive development. It is developed and sold by PTV Group and is generic, applied to sites anywhere. It is available under commercial licence, with a free trial and a student version. Caveats: it is proprietary and paid, and results depend on the network, demand and calibration data the user supplies. Vissim supports capacity planning of intersections and corridors, agent-based pedestrian simulation and digital twin applications. It complements PTV Visum for macroscopic planning and the SUMO open-source simulator catalogued here.
